summary: Sandbach United fell to a narrow 3-2 defeat against Foley Meir in what proved a frustrating encounter, with the team squandering several clear-cut chances and conceding from soft set pieces. Saul Shotton's late volley gave them hope late on, but they couldn't find the equalizer despite sustained pressure. The Bach will be looking to bounce back quickly when they travel to face Stafford Town on Saturday.
